NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Description follows the PR guide: testing notes, screenshots and the self-review checklist are there. But "Fixes:" is empty, the issue is written as `Fixes #<36878>` (angle brackets), the change list is messy, and two checklist items are unchecked. |
| ✅ | Take part in the CZO discussion: the author posted in the thread, and Daniel K replied that the PR isn't blocked and extends the filter UX from #24200. |
| ℹ️ | No new push since the feedback. The history still has two "ci:" retry commits, and the whole change is one commit touching 11 files (contenteditable switch, parsing, filtering, tests), which doesn't follow commit discipline. |
| ℹ️ | The author asked the bot to add "maintainer review" themselves, which only a triager should do. CI passes. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for engaging with the CZO thread! Before this can go to review, please fix the description to use `Fixes: #36878` on its own line and complete the self-review checklist. Please also drop the "ci:" retry commits and split the work into coherent commits, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
